title: PlanObject
description: v6.8 Task #148 — multi-step plan wrapper. QB may emit either a bare Intent (backward compat) OR a plan wrapper with an array of step objects. Each step is an Intent-like object where `target` and `content` may contain marker references (e.g. `$STEP_0_STDOUT`) that get resolved to prior-step outputs by the Executor before schema validation and dispatch. The resolved intent must pass intent.json strictly.

plan.description: Ordered list of steps. Max 10 steps per plan — a soft cap to prevent runaway plan generation. Steps execute sequentially, each with access to prior step results via `$STEP_<N>_STDOUT` markers.

action.description: MCP tool name. Same shape as intent.json.action. Markers ARE NOT ALLOWED here — attacker crafting a compound query must not be able to rewrite an action mid-plan. Pattern rejects `$`.

target.description: Primary target. MAY contain `$STEP_<N>_STDOUT` markers (which include `$`); Executor resolves them, then validates the resulting string against intent.json's strict pattern. This wrapper schema is looser than intent.json specifically to allow the marker.

params.description: Tool-specific parameters. In v6.8 Task #148 params does NOT support marker substitution (D15); only target and content do. Params values must satisfy intent.json's constraints already.

content.description: Optional verbatim payload (e.g. bytes for fs.write). MAY contain `$STEP_<N>_STDOUT` markers. Resolved before dispatch.

pb_hint.description: Optional PB coaching. Same as intent.json.pb_hint.

reason.description: Short human-facing summary of THIS step (not the whole plan). Rendered in HITL card + audit trail.

risk_level.description: QB's own risk assessment for this step. Risk classifier still runs at graph time; this field is informational + used for max-tier calculation.
